laws.rule: Yala (Ruhunu National Park): Category I national reserve. Foreign adult entry per person: tourist season USD 25 for a day visit (about A$35.51) or USD 50 overnight (A$71.02); regular period USD 20 (A$28.41) or USD 40 (A$56.82). Foreign child: USD 15 or 30 in season (A$21.31, A$42.61), USD 10 or 20 in regular period (A$14.20, A$28.41). Payable in US dollars or the equivalent in Sri Lanka rupees. Fees are subject to taxes and charges, and vehicle fees (Schedule V) are extra and not listed here. Children are 6 to 12 years; under 6 is free. A$ at RBA 30 Oct 2026: A$1 = USD 0.7040. Rates are from the 2022 gazette; the Director-General sets the tourist-season dates and later amendments were not checked. Bundala (Category II) pays the lower rate: foreign adult USD 12 a day (A$17.05). Yala also reaches into Uva Province.
